correctness.rationale: For q>=2, the ordinary half-word has unique greedy complete-alphabet arch factorization. Its arch enumerator is A_q=q!z^q/prod_{j=1}^{q-1}(1-jz); residual words are R_q=(1-A_q)/(1-qz), and exactly q-1-symbol residuals are S_q=A_q/z. Barker et al. midpoint lemma gives all even palindrome index exactly 2m and an odd palindrome index 2m or 2m+1 according as the center completes the deficient arch; the exact formal distributions E=R/(1-u^2 A) and O=[qR+(u-1)S]/(1-u^2 A) follow. The index-zero and empty-word cases and binary cancellation were checked. For uniformly random odd-palindrome half and center the completion is exactly renewal of uniform q-coupon collection at time h+1; its rational aperiodic generating function has sole simple unit-circle pole and mean qH_q, proving probability 1/(qH_q)+O_q(eta_q^h), eta_q<1. The mean result holds at fixed q, not uniformly growing q.
